name: @sigta/ui-assets
description: Asset pipeline for sigta/ui — bundles the editor (TipTap) into dist/. The core runtime (dist/sigta.js) stays a verbatim copy of resources/js/sigta.js.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:editor
scripts.build:editor: esbuild resources/js/editor.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --banner:js="/*! Sigta UI editor. Bundled third-party licenses: sigta-editor.js.LICENSE.txt */" --metafile=node_modules/.cache/sigta-editor.meta.json --outfile=dist/sigta-editor.js && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs node_modules/.cache/sigta-editor.meta.json dist/sigta-editor.js.LICENSE.txt
